Name: Wizarding crops
Author: Rinkablu
Description:
Wizarding crops adds magical plants from the harry potter wizarding world.

Version 1.0.0 adds:

Dittany: grows in the spring

Mandrake roots: Grows in the fall

Venomous Tentacula: grows in the summer


I plan to add more in the future, always welcome to suggestions!
